decision: Prioritize model-family metadata review under a fixed governance budget.
primary_outcome: Confirmed actionable metadata issues resolved per reviewer hour, with coverage by model family and download exposure.
denominator: All models in the explicitly frozen selected graph; neither the graph nor downloads represent all users or all models.
independence_unit: Root family; descendants can share the same inherited issue.
quality_guardrail: No legal verdict from metadata alone; track unresolved lineage and missing license fields.
minimum_data: Model/root IDs, snapshot date, ancestry edges, metadata fields, download measure definition, review disposition and time.
failure_handling: Missing license or ancestry stays unknown. Do not convert absent metadata into compliant or noncompliant labels.
release_rule: Prioritize transparent exposure scenarios while requiring qualified review for legal conclusions; report both counts and download weighting.
reversal: Ancestry errors, concentrated duplicated issues, or changed exposure weights alter which roots deserve priority.
status: PROPOSED MEASUREMENT CONTRACT; NOT AN EXECUTED DOMAIN EXPERIMENT
defense: No. Download counts are an activity proxy. I show both count concentration and download concentration without claiming unique-user exposure.
A root-level review may resolve a shared issue across descendants, but that benefit depends on verified inheritance, not graph position alone.
